name: ELLES (Innovative Health Solutions)
description: Mobile app covering women's health from puberty to menopause, with cycle and fertility tracking, pregnancy and postpartum support, specialist teleconsultations and cancer prevention content.

name: ABBEF (Association Burkinabè pour le Bien-Être Familial)
description: Family planning association that launched JOY, a free app giving young people sexual and reproductive health information and online consultations.

name: MSI Burkina Faso
description: Provides contraception, STI care, prenatal and postnatal care, post-abortion care and gender-based violence care across all regions of Burkina Faso.

name: MSI Mali
description: Family planning and reproductive healthcare provider in 12 regions of Mali, with post-abortion care and a gender-based violence response programme.

name: Sutura
description: Makes reusable sanitary pads and runs menstrual and reproductive health education in schools and conflict-affected areas.

name: MSI Niger
description: Provides modern contraception and sexual and reproductive health services in six of Niger's eight regions and trains public sector providers.

name: MSI Senegal
description: Runs fixed and mobile family planning and reproductive health services in all 14 regions of Senegal, working with the Ministry of Health.

name: MSI Sierra Leone
description: Provides contraception, post-abortion care, maternal health services, STI care and cervical cancer screening in 14 regions of Sierra Leone.

name: Uman Tok
description: Grassroots organisation that makes reusable menstrual kits with local tailors and teaches reproductive health in schools.

name: ATBEF (Association Togolaise pour le Bien-Être Familial)
description: Family planning association offering sexual and reproductive health services, HIV testing and treatment, prevention of mother-to-child transmission and remote consultations.

name: GquiOse
description: Youth sexual and reproductive health app from the Guinean bloggers association and Solthis, with cycle tracking, anonymous questions and clinic booking.

name: AIBEF Korhogo Clinic
description: Ivorian family planning association clinic offering gynaecology, antenatal and postnatal care, maternity, infertility care and cervical precancer screening.

name: Hamlin Fistula Ethiopia
description: Network of six fistula hospitals, a midwifery college and over 90 supported midwifery clinics treating and preventing obstetric fistula across Ethiopia.

name: MSI Ethiopia Reproductive Choices
description: Runs hospitals, clinics and outreach offering family planning, safe abortion care within Ethiopian law and maternal health services in most regions of the country.

name: Bina Products
description: Woman-led manufacturer of reusable, biodegradable sanitary pads made from local enset and banana fibre.

name: Kosmotive
description: Kigali social enterprise making KosmoPads reusable menstrual pads and running menstrual health education across Rwanda.

name: Edna Adan University Hospital
description: Nonprofit maternity and referral hospital in Hargeisa, Somaliland, providing obstetric and gynaecological care and training nurses and midwives.

name: Gynocare Women's and Fistula Hospital
description: Eldoret hospital offering free obstetric fistula repair, safe motherhood services and patient reintegration, and a FIGO fistula surgery training centre.

name: Aunty Jane Hotline
description: Toll-free Nairobi hotline staffed by trained counsellors giving information on contraception, unwanted pregnancy and safe abortion in English and Swahili.

name: CCBRT Maternity and Newborn Wing
description: Hospital wing caring for high-risk and emergency pregnancies, including mothers with disabilities and fistula histories, with family planning built into care.

name: Kairuki Green IVF Centre
description: Private fertility centre in Dar es Salaam offering IVF, including free treatment draws for women who cannot afford it.

name: Yommie Essentials
description: Juba social enterprise supplying affordable sanitary pads to girls and women in South Sudan, backed by Orange Corners.

name: Alsalam Factory
description: Women-led maker of reusable sanitary pads founded by Safiya Elfadni, relocated from Khartoum to Port Sudan during the war and now also running a Cairo branch.

name: ABUBEF
description: Burundi's IPPF member association, providing family planning, youth counselling and other sexual and reproductive health services since 1991.

name: Wekebere
description: Kampala startup building a wearable fetal monitor that shows the baby's heartbeat and labour contractions on the mother's phone and shares data with clinicians.

name: My Pregnancy Journey
description: Women-founded pregnancy app with week-by-week tracking, articles, videos and a directory of healthcare providers for mothers in Africa.

name: PinkDrive
description: Breast cancer nonprofit running mobile mammography and education units that offer free screening in underserved communities in Gauteng and Cape Town.

name: Medfem Fertility Clinic
description: Sandton fertility clinic offering IVF, ICSI, egg and embryo freezing, egg donation, surrogacy and endometriosis care.

name: Aevitas Fertility Clinic
description: Fertility clinic at Life Vincent Pallotti Hospital offering IVF, egg freezing, oncofertility and care for endometriosis and PCOS.

name: Wijnland Fertility Clinic
description: Fertility clinic offering IVF, ICSI, egg freezing, donor programmes, a miscarriage clinic and fertility preservation.

name: Mina Foundation
description: Makes the South African Mina silicone menstrual cup and donates cups through a buy-one, donate-one model to address period poverty.

name: Lindiwe Sanitary Pads
description: Women-owned sanitary pad manufacturer with a Centurion factory that exports to 11 African countries and donates pads to schoolgirls.

name: Perinatal Mental Health Project
description: University of Cape Town project that trains providers and advocates for integrating maternal mental health care into routine pregnancy and postnatal services.

name: Link to Life
description: Cancer support NGO that runs free breast screening with portable ultrasound and supports breast cancer survivors with counselling and prostheses.

name: Marie Stopes Madagascar
description: MSI programme providing contraception, post-abortion care, maternal health services and cervical cancer screening across Madagascar.

name: Population Services Zimbabwe
description: Sexual and reproductive health provider offering contraception, post-abortion care, cervical cancer screening and STI testing in all ten provinces.

name: Journey of Hope Botswana
description: Breast cancer nonprofit whose annual Big Journey convoy offers free breast screenings and awareness across Botswana.

name: Shemsi
description: Cairo-based maker of washable, reusable period underwear sold with instalment plans to ease the upfront cost.

name: Rahet Bally
description: Motherhood support platform founded by Nadia Gamal El Din offering expert Q&As, wellness programs, an app and The Cloud, a physical space for mothers with childcare.

name: Baheya Foundation
description: Nonprofit breast cancer hospital offering free early detection, treatment and psychological support for women, with an AI screening system developed with the Applied Innovation Center.

name: Breast Cancer Foundation of Egypt
description: Charity running free mobile breast cancer screening caravans with mammography and ultrasound, plus awareness and survivor support programs across Egypt.

name: Egyptian Family Planning Association
description: IPPF member association founded in 1958 that provides family planning, sexuality education and clinics for women and girls subjected to violence, in partnership with UNFPA.

name: Association Marocaine de Planification Familiale (AMPF)
description: Moroccan IPPF member founded in 1971 that delivers sexual and reproductive health services, family planning and sexuality education.

name: IRIFIV
description: Casablanca fertility centre offering diagnosis, insemination, IVF and ICSI, describing itself as the first assisted reproduction centre in Morocco.

name: Association Tunisienne de la Santé de la Reproduction (ATSR)
description: IPPF member since 1969 running service points and mobile units for sexual, reproductive and maternal health, including early breast cancer detection.

name: Sexo Santé (ONFP)
description: Free sexual and reproductive health app from Tunisia's national family and population office covering puberty, pregnancy, contraception and STIs.

name: Banet
description: Tunis startup connecting women with health professionals through consultations, confidential chat and specialist-led support groups.

name: Association Algérienne pour la Planification Familiale (AAPF)
description: Algerian IPPF member founded in 1987 working on sexual and reproductive health, sexuality education and campaigns against violence toward women.

name: Association El Amel CPMC
description: Cancer support association at the Centre Pierre et Marie Curie that runs Algeria's mobile breast cancer screening unit, the Mammobile.

name: FERTIVAL (Groupe Clinique du Val)
description: Private assisted reproduction clinic opened in January 2025 offering fertility assessments, IUI, IVF, ICSI and egg and embryo freezing.

name: CAMNAFAW
description: Cameroon's IPPF member association, running sexual and reproductive health clinics in Yaoundé and Douala plus youth centres across the country.

name: CBCHS Women's Health Program
description: Cameroon Baptist Convention Health Services programme that has screened tens of thousands of women for cervical cancer using nurse-led visual inspection and same-day treatment.

name: BornFyne
description: Prenatal care app linked to a web portal, built by the research centre CIRES and piloted with the Ministry of Public Health in several Cameroonian health districts.

name: Panzi Foundation & Hospital
description: Hospital and foundation started by Dr Denis Mukwege that treats survivors of sexual violence and women with complex gynaecological injuries.

name: HEAL Africa
description: Goma referral hospital offering free obstetric fistula repair and gynaecological care, with outreach surgery campaigns in other provinces.

name: ASTBEF
description: Chad's family welfare association, running family planning clinics in N'Djamena and contraception awareness campaigns in the regions.

name: ACABEF
description: IPPF member association offering contraception, HIV care, infertility treatment and maternal health services from clinics in Bangui and Mbaiki.

name: ASPF São Tomé
description: Nonprofit providing family planning, safe motherhood and sexual and reproductive health services to women and young people since 1995.

name: ALUCAF
description: Libreville association fighting women's cancers through awareness days that promote self-examination and early screening.

name: Mbotama Elamou
description: Pregnancy follow-up app that lets a partner and the fire service locate a woman once labour starts, awarded at the 2021 Denis Sassou-N'Guesso digital innovation prize.
